description: This file defines the Vtiger_QuotePDFController class, which extends the InventoryPDFController to generate PDF representations of quotes, including headers, watermarks, and addresses within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: Vtiger_QuotePDFController
classes.description: A controller class for generating quote PDFs within vtiger CRM, extending InventoryPDFController.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelTitle
methods.description: Builds the title for the PDF header, translating the quote module name and quote number.

methods.name: getWatermarkContent
methods.description: Returns the content for the watermark, based on the quote status.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelColumnRight
methods.description: Builds the right-side header columns with issue date, valid date, billing, and shipping addresses.
